points.description: Number of points needed to redeem the reward. Required for reward of type POINTS.

categories.description: List of categories of this reward. Required for reward of type POINTS.

moreInfoURL.description: URL where a user can find more info about this reward. Required for reward of type POINTS.

applicableCardSystems.description: List of CardSystems whose members can redeem this reward.

allCardSystems.description: If set to true, `applicableCardSystems` will always contain all UiTPAS CardSystems.

organizers.description: List of Organizers where this reward can be redeemed.

maxAvailableUnits.description: Maximum (total) available units of this reward.

practicalInfo.description: Practical info for passholders who want to redeem this reward.

pictures.description: List of URLs to zero or more images of this reward.

forKids.description: true if this reward is specifically targetted to children.

sport.description: true if this is a sport reward

featured.description: true if this reward is currently set as 'featured'

online.description: true if this reward can be redeemed online

lastChance.description: true if this rewards will not be redeemable anymore in the near future

redeemConstraint.description: Defines how many times this reward can be redeemed by the same passholder in a specific period.

volume.description: The maximum number of times this reward can be redeemed by the same passholder.

period.description:
The calendar period this volume constraint applies to:
- `ABSOLUTE`: the constraint applies to any period.
- `DAY`: the constraint applies from 00:00 to 23:59
- `WEEK`: the constraint applies from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59
- `MONTH`: the constraint applies from the first of the month at 00:00 to the last day of the month 23:59
- `QUARTER`: this constraint applies to the first day of the quarter to the last day: January-March, April-June, July-September, October-December.
- `YEAR`: from the Jan 1st to Dec 31st

CardSystem.title: CardSystem
CardSystem.description: A region, usually one or multiple municipalities in Belgium, that uses UiTPAS and provides discounts and/or rewards. For example "Paspartoe" (Brussels), UiTPAS Leuven, UiTPAS Hasselt, UiTPAS Gent, and so on.

name.description: Name of the card system. This field is always available in responses.

branding.description: Branding information of the card system

logo.description: URL to the logo of the card system

primaryColor.description: Color code of the primary branding color.

secondaryColor.description: Color code of the secondary branding color.

website.description: URL of the website of the card system

cities.description: List of cities that are part of this card system

permanent.description: Indicates whether this is a permanent card system

allowsCardlessRegistration.description: Indicates if cardless registration is enabled

cardlessRegistrationType.description: Indicates the types of online cardless registrations this cardsystem supports.

socialTariffInfo.description: Optional information about social tariff entitlement in this card system.

Organizer.title: Organizer
Organizer.description: An organisation that partners with UiTPAS to provide discounts and/or rewards, and/or allows points to be collected at their events.

id.description: Unique ID of an UiTPAS organizer. (Same as its ID in UiTdatabank)

name.description: Human-readable name of an UiTPAS organizer.

cardSystems.description: Card systems linked to this organizer

linkedLocationId.description: ID of the location linked to this organizer.

address.description: Address of this organizer. This property is alway available in responses.

Period.title: Period
Period.description: Period entity with a begin and optional end date.
